f.pu: To protect the coral communities and significant biodiversity of Kayankerni Marine Sanctuary.
f.re: Visitors must follow the following guidelines when entering Kayankerni Marine Sanctuary: 1. Do not touch, step on or walk on corals or other marine life. 2. Be careful and watch your fins when snorkelling and diving. You can easily break corals when you kick. 3. Do not collect or purchase corals, shells or other such marine animals and plants as souvenirs. 4. Do not engage in any fishing within the Marine Sanctuary.…
